answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the voyage check immediately, the ripple audit keeps the resolved set and the jade replay exposes exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 69 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 69 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
